headline: At 28 years old
body: His growth plates were still wide open. | His testosterone was normal. Slightly high, even. | He was fully masculinised. Everything androgen driven worked exactly as it should.
punch: ==One broken gene was the only difference.==

headline: The gene
body: coded for his *estrogen receptor*. | The hormone was in his blood. The receiver was broken. | So his body could make estrogen and could not read it.
punch: _His plates never got the signal to close._

headline: Then they tested it
body: They gave him estrogen for six months. | His free estradiol went up about **tenfold**. | Nothing happened. No bone response at all.
punch: Hormone present. Receiver broken. ==Plates stayed open.==

headline: Which proves
body: *Estrogen* is what closes your growth plates. | Not testosterone. Not growth hormone. Not age. | *Estrogen* acting on *estrogen receptors* in your cartilage cells.
punch: _This is the single most important fact in height._

headline: So where does
body: your estrogen come from if you are male? | *Aromatase* converts testosterone into *estradiol*. | And your growth plate runs that enzyme itself.
punch: ==Your cartilage makes the hormone that closes it.==

headline: This was measured
body: in actual human growth plate tissue. | Taken from adolescents during epiphysiodesis surgery. | *Aromatase* transcripts detected by RT-PCR, protein localised in the plate.
punch: **Human tissue.** Not a mouse. Not a cell line.

headline: And the plate
body: responds to what it makes. | A human chondrocyte line produced *17 beta estradiol* and reacted to it. | Proliferation and apoptosis both changed.

headline: Which means
body: Your serum estradiol underestimates what your plate is exposed to. | Local production happens where no blood test reaches. | Two people with identical bloodwork can have different plate exposure.
punch: ==The number you can measure is not the number that matters.==

headline: Run it backwards
body: Block *aromatase* in boys with *letrozole* or *anastrozole*. | Bone maturation slows down. | Adult height goes up.
punch: _Block the conversion and you delay the closure._

headline: Second confirmation
body: Another man could not make estrogen at all. *Aromatase* deficiency. | Normal testosterone. Open plates as an adult. Low bone mass. | They gave him estrogen and his bone density rose substantially.

headline: So the hierarchy
body: Testosterone matters mostly because of what it becomes. | The fraction that aromatises is the fraction that closes you. | The fraction that becomes *DHT* cannot aromatise and cannot close you.
punch: ==Ask what it turns into. Not how much you have.==
